steps.title: Present the code
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen showing a payment QR code, a countdown until the code refreshes, and a masked source account.
steps.caption: The customer shows a payment code at the counter. The screen keeps the code readable and makes its expiry visible.

steps.title: Awaiting confirmation
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen with a progress indicator reading 'Waiting for the merchant' and a note that the receipt will also arrive as a notification.
steps.caption: After scanning, the result arrives asynchronously. The screen says what is happening and that a notification will follow if the app is closed.

steps.title: Receipt feedback
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen showing a successful payment receipt with a sample merchant, amount and reference, above a notification banner.
steps.caption: The outcome is confirmed with a receipt summary, whether the customer stayed on screen or returned from a notification.

steps.title: Card information
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen showing a sample card with masked number, status, and actions for block, activate and change PIN.
steps.caption: Card details and the actions that apply to the card's current status appear together.

steps.title: Partial-data failure
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen where the card summary is shown but one section reads 'Limit details unavailable' with a Retry button.
steps.caption: When one part fails to load, the rest of the screen stays useful and the failed section offers its own retry.

steps.title: Recovered information
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen with every section loaded, including the previously failed limit details.
steps.caption: After a retry, the missing section is filled in and the rest of the screen stays where it was.
